message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible in the data-acquisition code paths shown; data is read from files and passed along without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data loading uses local file reads (read_csv, read_json, load_csvs, load_pickle, etc.) with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or authenticated remote fetches visible in any of the code slices.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or noise-detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the shown code paths.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is applied to the training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code imports torch's save/load and loads pickled/CSV data, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading any serialized model or pretrained weights.

No detected label distribution validation: The code includes undersampling of the majority class and iterative stratified splitting, but no explicit pre-training validation of label distribution or class balance checks before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger detection mechanism present in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial attack/stress-test routines are present in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is performed via split_target(), there is no signing, hashing, or isolation mechanism to protect evaluation data from tampering, and only a single evaluation path is visible without multiple independent metric sources.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection is visible anywhere in the inference data-flow path shown.

No detected output bounds checks: Although a `logit2label` utility and threshold-based discretization functions exist, no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or post-inference output validation are applied on the inference output path shown.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses a GNN/BiLSTM classifier for tweet classification, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
